findings.source: Shared entities, account isolation, async media and cancellation
findings.current: Several async writers only compare owner or session.expires_at, which a same-clock re-login can reuse

findings.source: Expanded/Chat/group overlays, block and session invalidation

approved_deltas: Existing real safe-area, canonical entity and local account boundaries retained

contracts.preconditions: Hydrated unchanged auth context and valid owned entities
contracts.visible_feedback: Existing source confirmation and 500ms write Loading
contracts.success_result: Same-ID getters synchronize across screens; refresh restores persistence without reseeding
contracts.failure_result: Prior state retained; scoped cancellation and staged media compensation
contracts.persistence: Existing v2 metadata and IndexedDB blobs only
contracts.acceptance: Explicit domain regression, real browser interactions, fresh WebKit documents and fail-closed boundary checks
